title: Handoff Session Receipt
description: Machine-readable form of the [Handoff session receipt] text block. Field names and allowed values match SKILL.md. receipt_schema_version 4 adds duration and codex_job_durations, both measured from repo state rather than recalled.

claude_session.description: Claude Code session id, or the literal string 'none'.

duration.description: Wall clock from the .handoff/session-start marker to the receipt, as '74min 05sec'. Wall clock means time blocked on a human approval is counted.

checks.description: Commands run, or an explicit statement that none were run.

anomalies.description: 'none' or a short description: job stalled, job failed, takeback, failed check, other.

codex_jobs.description: Number of delegate-codex.sh background jobs, including fix rounds. 0 when none were used.

codex_job_durations.description: 'none', or per-job wall clock as 'jobId=74min 05sec' entries joined by '; ', oldest first. Measured from each job's meta submitted_at to the mtime of its exit_code; a job still running reads 'running'. Jobs submitted before the session start belong to an earlier run and are left out.

scope.description: Configuration scope in effect, or n/a when no configured role was touched.

config_source.description: Highest-priority layer that supplied the resolved config, per docs/config-schema.md; n/a when no configured role was touched.

roles_used.description: 'none', or a JSON array of every role invoked this run: {role, host, model, effort, verified}. Here 'host' is the CLI that executed the role, not the runtime that loaded SKILL.md. An unverified role is still listed, never omitted.

receipt_schema_version.description: Always 4 for this contract; a receipt without duration and codex_job_durations is a v3 receipt.
